name: 22642-prefillburst-qwen2moe57b-dp8
parallelism: tp8, dp8, ep8 with data-parallel attention on (dp_size == ep_size == tp_size == 8), PP=1, one node.
architecture: Qwen2MoeForCausalLM, 28 decoder layers all sparse MoE, 64 routed experts with top-8 routing plus one shared, GQA 28 heads over 4 KV heads at head_dim 128, hidden 3584, 32768 max positions.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=512, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 5120 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, no prefix reuse: 1000 prompt tokens in and ONE token out, both fixed (stdev 0, min == max), temperature 0.0, seed 0. The prefix cache is off, so every request prefills its whole prompt cold.
purpose: A bulk document classifier labeling thousand-word texts with one-word verdicts for 512 concurrent users on eight GPUs.
launch:
# The launch line. Everything not named here is a stock default of the pinned commit.
model-path: Qwen/Qwen2-57B-A14B-Instruct

tp-size: 8
dp-size: 8
ep-size: 8
enable-dp-attention: true

# Off so all 5120 requests pay their full 1000 prompt tokens.
disable-radix-cache: true

# Not a default: left unset this commit derives 512 on an 80 GB card at tp>=4, and graph
# buffers scale with it -- ~18 GB per card, plus minutes of capture across 28 layers and
# eight ranks. 512 streams over 8 ranks is 64 per rank, so 128 leaves room to double them.
cuda-graph-max-bs: 128
